wins.text: Total revenue of $68B, up 73% YoY and accelerating from Q3; data center revenue of $62B up 75% YoY and 22% sequentially, adding $11B sequentially — a record sequential gain
Full-year data center revenue of $194B, up 68% YoY; networking revenue exceeded $31B for the full year, up more than 10x vs. fiscal 2021
Non-GAAP gross margin of 75.2%, increasing sequentially as Blackwell ramped; free cash flow of $35B in Q4 and $97B for fiscal 2026
Professional Visualization crossed $1B for the first time at $1.3B, up 159% YoY and 74% sequentially; Gaming revenue of $3.7B up 47% YoY
Sovereign AI business more than tripled YoY to over $30B in fiscal 2026; networking revenue of $11B in Q4, up more than 3.5x YoY

risks.text: Gaming expected to face supply constraints in Q1 and beyond due to memory tightness; management unable to confirm YoY growth for fiscal 2027
No China data center compute revenue assumed in Q1 outlook; H200 approvals granted but no revenue generated yet, and import allowance remains uncertain
Chinese competitors bolstered by recent IPOs are making progress and 'have the potential to disrupt the structure of the global AI industry over the long term'
GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses expected to grow in the low 40s% YoY in fiscal 2027 as R&D and infrastructure costs scale; SBC now included in non-GAAP, adding ~$1.9B per quarter
Vera Rubin transition timing uncertain for H2; Blackwell and Rubin may overlap in market, creating potential execution complexity and gross margin variability during ramp

guidance_items.detail: Q1 FY2027 total revenue guided to $78B +/- 2%, up from Q4 actual of $68B; sequential growth expected throughout all of calendar 2026, exceeding prior $500B Blackwell/Rubin opportunity framework
Q1 GAAP gross margin ~74.9%, non-GAAP ~75%, +/- 50 bps; full-year gross margins expected in the mid-70s
Full-year non-GAAP operating expenses expected to grow in the low 40s% YoY, reflecting continued investment in expanding opportunity set
FY2027 GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates expected between 17%-19%, excluding discrete items; SBC now included in non-GAAP starting Q1

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Sustainability of hyperscaler CapEx growth into 2026 and beyond given cash flow compression
Capital allocation strategy — why not a larger share repurchase program given ~$100B annual FCF generation
Space-based data centers as a future compute frontier
